scope: Gated proposals after the follow-up, not executed full campaigns.

designs.question: Does a structured blind solver remain competitive at degrees with substantial fresh-target coverage?
designs.instances: p=257,1021,4093,16381,65537; 3 independently seeded split pencils per p; degrees 1,2,3,4 initially; 30 fresh non-base finite targets per cell. Increase degree only after an exact count/coverage screen.
solvers: Blind geometric class construction with base-locus recovery charged
A sparse coefficient solver with saturation and multiple primitive charts
Known-generator lattice search as a labeled oracle control
measurements: Coverage at each degree including all chart exclusions
Single-target cold and shared-precomputation batch costs
Completed recovered-log operation including preprocessing, failures, coordinate extraction and verification
Timeout-censored distributions; planted controls reported separately
controls: Workers use only surface equations and target; audit that known generator/scalar data is not referenced
Every returned section satisfies the polynomial identity and gives a verified specialization log
Matched success uses fallback rho charged for every failed section target
At least one independent surface held out per size
designs.stopping_rule: Stop a blind solver line after two cells with over 50% timeouts at a 10-second per-target cap. Do not extend the campaign unless a held-out matched-coverage comparison improves as p grows. Fixed-rank polynomial class enumeration is a control, not evidence of a new exponent.

designs.question: Can an explicit certified construction exceed rank 8 through prescribed generic ordinary fibres without excessive height or setup cost?
designs.instances: First audit one explicit chi=2 construction at p=101,257,1021 on 10 prescribed j/twist targets per p; retain the split rank-8 pencil as control.
measurements: Explicit independent sections and certified Gram determinant
controls: Do not infer rank from point counts only through extension degree 10
Use a theorem with checked hypotheses, or independent sections plus a certified upper bound
Separate special-j or constant-j families from generic prescribed targets
designs.stopping_rule: Stop this construction if rank>8 through generic prescribed fibres is not certified within the cap. Do not launch a thousands-of-surfaces survey on an uncertified rank estimator.

designs.decision: Park this particular m=2 norm method. Reopen only for a distinct algorithm or cost model with a completed-operation advantage over the native baseline.
controls: A native enumeration implementation and shared factor-base setup are mandatory
No exponent inferred from microsecond small-field timings
A full relation-yield and matrix-cost model is required before an index-calculus claim

restrictions.instance_scope: Synthetic or known-answer small prime fields. No deployed keys or private-key recovery.
restrictions.no_sieving: SNFS-B4 prohibits sieving under all circumstances.
restrictions.evidence: Original theorem-closed records remain receipt-only. Measurements do not certify asymptotic lower bounds, universal impossibility, or subexponential ECDLP.
restrictions.cost_accounting: Record input-generation costs separately; charge all algorithm-required setup, preprocessing, failed targets, output materialization, coordinate recovery, and verification. Report single-target and amortized costs separately.
restrictions.statistics: Predeclare sample law, excluded exceptional strata and hypotheses. Use independent instances, held-out curves/sizes, confidence intervals, multiple-testing control where applicable, and explicit timeout censoring.
restrictions.resources: Per-stage CPU caps below are proposed initial screening caps, not measured campaign costs or execution already completed.
restrictions.dependencies: Sage/Magma or equivalent certified packages are still needed for full p-adic precision, number-field descent, general section solvers, Jacobian arithmetic and random-surface rank certification.
